content: Black Friday is here, and if you want a little help keeping your floors clean this holiday season, now is a great time to pick up a robot vacuum. Some of the best models we’ve tested over the last year or two are on sale for up to 60 percent off, whether you’re after a basic robovac for quick cleanups or a more advanced model that vacuums, mops, and practically takes care of itself. This year’s sale has made some pricier robot vacuums a lot more affordable. The Eufy Omni C28, for example, now costs about what you’d expect to pay for a budget bot, while the Matic — which impressed us with its almost humanlike navigation — is getting a rare discount in the form of a bundle. If none of those are quite what you’re looking for, we’ve also found good deals on models from Roborock, Dreame, and more, with picks below for a variety of budgets and cleaning needs. chineseContent: 黑色星期五到了，如果您在这个假期期间需要一些帮助来保持地板清洁，那么现在是购买机器人真空吸尘器的好时机。我们在过去一两年测试过的一些最好的型号都以高达 60% 的折扣出售，无论您是想要快速清洁的基本扫地机器人，还是可以吸尘、拖地和几乎可以自我照顾的更高级型号。今年的促销活动让一些价格较高的扫地机器人变得更加实惠。例如，Eufy Omni C28 现在的价格与预算机器人的价格差不多，而 Matic——以其近乎人性化的导航给我们留下了深刻的印象——以捆绑的形式获得了罕见的折扣。如果这些都不是您想要的，我们还找到了 Roborock、Dreame 等型号的超值优惠，下面的精选可满足各种预算和清洁需求。 [产品：Roborock Qrevo Curv 2 Flow | https://www.amazon.com/roborock-Qrevo-Curv-Flow-Self-Cleaning/dp/B0FXG2BDTJ?tag=theverge02-20， https://roborock.pxf.io/c/482924/1179705/14848?u=https%3A%2F%2Fus.roborock.com%2Fproducts%2Froborock-qrevo-curv-2-flow]【产品：石头扫地机器人Q10 S5 Plus | https://www.amazon.com/roborock-Q10-S5-Self-Emptying-Anti-Tangle/dp/B0DWXBCQVP?tag=theverge02-20， https://roborock.pxf.io/c/482924/1179705/14848?u=https%3A%2F%2Fus.roborock.com%2Fproducts%2Froborock-q10-s5-plus] [产品：Matic 扫地机器人 | https://maticrobots.pxf.io/c/482924/3926405/53892?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmaticrobots.com%2F，https://maticrobots.pxf.io/c/482924/3926405/53892?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmaticrobots.com%2F] [产品：欧菲 Omni C28 | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWK41WF2?tag=theverge02-20， https://eufy-us.sjv.io/c/482924/999452/13094?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.eufy.com%2Fproducts%2Ft211a110%3Fvariant%3D45573047124154] [产品：Dreame X60 Ultra
